title: THE BIRTH CARD: A KIT YOU CANNOT PAY FOR STAYS READABLE, THE PICKED HEIR HAS A BAR
why: the critic on the birth card, P1: the whole row of a kit he cannot pay for faded to about 3:1, and only a 1px outline marked the picked heir
now: a kit he cannot pay for keeps its words in grey with the price in red at full opacity, still not selectable; the picked heir card has a 6px lime bar on its left edge

edits.replacement: '#root #birthmodal .bhcard.on{border-color:var(--acc);background:var(--ui-raised);box-shadow:inset 6px 0 0 var(--acc)}'+   // v37.xx (cw-m2birth3), critic P1: the picked heir carries a 6px lime bar
